info.title: Panneau protocol
info.description: The HTTP API between a Panneau frontend and its backend. Paths are relative to `api.baseUrl` of the definition. Authentication is up to the backend (session cookie or bearer token). Errors use `application/problem+json`.

get.summary: The definition for the current user, in the current locale.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated fields; a `-` prefix sorts descending.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: `filter[status]=published`; `filter[tags][]=a&filter[tags][]=b` for any of several values; `filter[published_at][from]=2026-01-01&filter[published_at][to]=2026-01-31` for the inclusive bounds of a range filter (`date-range`), without the open end.

200.description: The widget's data. Its shape depends on the widget type.

Id.description: Opaque identifier. Clients never parse or generate ids.

Abilities.description: What the current user can do, keyed by ability (`viewAny`, `create`, `update`, `delete`, or an action id).

route.description: Name of a route in the definition.

field.description: Field name, or a dot path.

Condition.description: A condition on form values: compare one field (`equals`, `in`, `notIn`, `filled`), or combine conditions with `all` or `any`.

message.description: Message shown when the rule fails, instead of the default one.

anyOf.description: A rule added in a later version of the protocol. Clients that don't know it ignore it; the server still enforces it.

Rule.description: A portable validation rule. `min` and `max` apply to numbers, and to the length of text and arrays. `accept` lists MIME types (`image/*`). `maxSize` is in bytes.

type.description: A built-in field type, or a type provided by a plugin.

localized.description: The value is an object keyed by locale.

from.description: `slug`: the field the slug is generated from.

display.description: Display used in lists, when it differs from the default one of the type.

types.description: `repeater`: typed blocks, each with its own fields.

type.description: A built-in node type, or a type provided by a plugin.

component.description: `component`: a component provided by a plugin.

width.description: Width on a 12-column grid, inside a `row`.

LayoutNode.description: A node of a form layout. Containers (`row`, `column`, `section`, `tabs`, `tab`, `sidebar`) have `children`. Fields that no node references are appended at the end of the form.

field.description: The field shown in the column.

id.description: Id of a column that is not a field.

type.description: Built-in: `text`, `select`, `toggle`, `date`, `date-range`, `relation`. A `date-range` value is the bounds of a range: `filter[id][from]` and `filter[id][to]`, days (`2026-01-31`), both inclusive and both optional.

sorts.description: Fields the list can be sorted by.

defaultSort.description: Same format as the `sort` query parameter: `-published_at,title`.

message.description: ICU message. `{count}` is the number of items.

kind.description: `server` calls the action endpoint; `link` navigates; `client` runs a plugin handler.

queued.description: The action always answers `202` with a run.

dryRun.description: The backend answers dry runs of this action (`dryRun` in the request): lists ask it how many items of a query selection will be skipped. Without it, the UI never sends `dryRun`, since a backend that ignores it would run the action.

url.description: `link`: URL template, with `{id}` for the item.

route.description: `link`: name of a route in the definition.

abilities.description: `run`: whether the current user can run the action on the resource.

Action.description: An operation on one item, a selection, or the whole resource.

search.description: Whether the resource is in the global search.

itemTitle.description: The field used as the title of an item, in lists and pickers.

types.description: Variants of the resource, each with its own extra fields.

Resource.description: A set of items managed in the admin.

url.description: Where the login with this provider starts.

mode.description: `panneau`: Panneau's own login pages. `external`: the site handles login.

component.description: A page provided by a plugin, or a built-in page.

ThemeTokens.description: CSS variables without the leading `--`, and their values: `{ "panneau-color-accent": "#05f" }`. Values cannot contain `{`, `}`, `;` or `<`.

solidHover.description: Background of the solid appearance on hover.

anyOf.description: One color, from which Panneau derives the others.

solidHover.description: Background of the solid appearance on hover.
Background of the solid appearance on hover.

ToneInput.description: A tone: one color, or every value with dark scheme overrides.

ThemeFontFace.description: A font face, written as an `@font-face` rule.

ThemeFontStylesheet.description: A hosted stylesheet that declares font faces.

tokens.description: Tokens of the light scheme, or of both schemes when `dark` does not set them.

dark.description: Tokens that change in the dark scheme.

palette.description: Raw colors, written as `--panneau-palette-<name>`: tokens and tones use them with `var(--panneau-palette-<name>)`.

tones.description: Tones added or redefined by the theme, applied by `panneau-tone-<name>`.

components.description: Named variants of components: tokens applied by `panneau-<component>-variant-<name>`.

densities.description: Tokens of each density (`panneau-control-height`…), which change with the density of the root.

fonts.description: Font faces and font stylesheets, added to the page once.

Theme.description: A theme of `@panneau/ui`, as plain data (decision 0024).

tokens.description: Tokens of the light scheme, or of both schemes when `dark` does not set them.

dark.description: Tokens that change in the dark scheme.

palette.description: Raw colors, written as `--panneau-palette-<name>`: tokens and tones use them with `var(--panneau-palette-<name>)`.

tones.description: Tones added or redefined by the theme, applied by `panneau-tone-<name>`.

components.description: Named variants of components: tokens applied by `panneau-<component>-variant-<name>`.

densities.description: Tokens of each density (`panneau-control-height`…), which change with the density of the root.

fonts.description: Font faces and font stylesheets, added to the page once.

extends.description: Themes registered by plugins, by id, that this theme builds on, in order: its own values override theirs.

DefinitionTheme.description: The theme of the admin: a theme, built on themes of plugins.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale of the labels and messages.

routes.description: Named paths of the frontend, for `link` actions and redirects.

Definition.description: Everything a frontend needs to render the admin for the current user.

version.description: Changes on every update. `null` when the backend has no versions.

Item.description: An item of a resource. Its other properties are the values of its fields.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type.

errors.description: `422`: messages keyed by the dot path of the invalid value.

current.description: `412`: the current version of the item.

Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`).

filter.description: The `filter` of the list query, by filter id: a value, a list of values, or the bounds of a range (`{ "from": "2026-01-01", "to": "2026-01-31" }`).

selection.description: Omitted for actions on the whole resource.

dryRun.description: Answer what the action would do without running it: a `200` action result whose `summary` counts the items that would succeed and those that would be skipped. Only for actions with `dryRun: true`.

results.description: The items that did not succeed.

result.description: Set once the run has finished.

crop.description: In pixels of the original image.

focalPoint.description: Relative to the width and height, from 0 to 1.

version.description: Changes on every update. `null` when the backend has no versions.
